protocol-monitor: replace sentAt-based latency with dedicated 5s ping protocol — peer pings gateway and gateway pings each peer independently, each direction's RTT measured with single clock so the result is mechanically honest within the ping (no clock-sync state, no symmetry assumption between directions). Add iptables-nft FORWARD/MASQUERADE rules for exit-node traffic

AL2023 routes iptables to iptables-nft by default; Docker installs a
DROP policy on the nft FORWARD chain. Tailscale's containerized daemon
writes its own NAT/forward rules to the iptables-legacy table family,
